title: Activities
raw_text:
9/29/26, 10:19 AM
You can execute the Rescheduling of Disconnection/Reconnection Orders report, which allows you to reschedule one or several

disconnection or reconnection orders.

Activities

1. Access the corresponding screen by way of the SAP Easy Access menu (|/+UtilitiesIndustry >» CustomerService
ProcessExecution » Disconnection/Reconnection » Reschedule Disconnection Orders 9) ).

2. Specify the selection criteria for the orders you wish to reschedule.

3. Choose the Execute button to reschedule the selected orders right away, or choose the Schedule Job button to specify a

date and time.

For more information on the selection criteria, refer to the corresponding report documentation, which you can access from the

selection screen.

Note that is is not possible to change either of the the disconnection dates (agreed date or planned date) if a service order has

already been generated.
